questions.question:
Arrange the following in a logical and meaningful order.

I. Superintendent of Police

II. Station House Officer

III. Inspector General

IV. Deputy Superintendent of Police
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

These all are the names of the post of police officers** **and we can arrange them in ascending order or descending order of their ranks.

**1.** Ascending order of their ranks is as follows:

**Station House Officer → **Deputy Superintendent of Police → Superintendent of Police → Inspector General 

**2. **Descending order of their ranks as follows:

 Inspector General → Superintendent of Police → Deputy Superintendent of Police → Station House Officer

Thus, the arrangement of these posts in a logical and meaningful order is as follows:

**II, IV, I, III (Ascending order)**

Hence, **"II, IV, I, III"**** **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
 

 Inspector General 
 A senior police officer in the police force
 
 

 Superintendent of Police
 Head of the police force of a district
 
 

 Deputy Superintendent of Police 
 They are state police officers who belong to the provincial police forces.
 
 

 Station House Officer
 He is the head in charge of the locality police station

questions.question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the followings items of a book in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Preface

2. Content list

3. Chapters

4. Bibliography

5. Cover Page
questions.solution:
The logical and meaningful order of the given words is as follows:

**LOGIC: **The words have been arranged according to the book format.

**5. Cover Page:-** It is one of the first pages you encounter after you open the *book where title is written.*

**1. Preface:- **After cover page a preface page is written from the point of view of the book author.

**2. Content list:- **After preface page the contents list of a book show list of different chapters and sections.

**3. Chapters:- **After the content list of chapters comes details of chapter.

**4. Bibliography:- **Last page of any book where written sources of information on a book called bibliography.

Hence, **"5, 1, 2, 3, 4" **is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__****Bibliography **→ A bibliography is a list of all of the sources you have used (whether referenced or not) in the process of researching your work. In general, a bibliography should include: the authors' names. the titles of the works. the names and locations of the companies that published your copies of the sources.

questions.question:
Arrange the following in a logical and meaningful order.

I. Kamet

II. Kanchenjunga

III. Nanda Devi

IV. Saltoro Kangri
questions.solution:
**This mountain ranges are arranged according to their location from North to South:-**

__**Key Points:**__

IV. Saltoro Kangri → ​It is located near the Siachen region, Northwest India. 

I. Kamet → It is the mountain peak of the Himalayas in Uttarakhand, northern India after Nanda Devi.

III. Nanda Devi → It is the mountain peak of the Himalayas in Uttarakhand, northern India.

II. Kanchenjunga → ​It is located Nepali Kumbhkaran Lungur, East india. 

__**Additional Information**__

 
• **Nanda Devi (7816 metres):**

 
 
• It is a part of Himalayan mountain ranges (Garhwal).
 
• This is the highest peak located entirely within India.
 
• The Nanda Devi National Prak, located in vicinity to the peak, consists of the best high altitude flora and fauna.
 
 
 
• **Kamet (7,756 metres):**
 
 
• **​**Kamet, mountain peak of the Himalayas in **Uttarakhand state**, northern India, **near the border with the Tibet Autonomous Region of China**.
 
• It is part of the **Zaskar range**.
 
 
 
• **Saltoro Kangri (7742 meters):**
 
 
• **​**It is located **near the Siachen Region**.
 
• The Saltoro Kangri is ranked the** 31st highest independent peak in the world**.
 
• It **lies in Saltoro range** (a part of **Karakoram Mountain range**)
 
 
 
• **Kanchenjunga (****8,586 metres****):**
 
 
• **​**It is located in Nepali **Kumbhkaran Lungur**.
 
• The **Kanchenjunga** is ranked the world’s third-highest mountain.
 
• It is a part of the Great Himalaya Range.
 
 

Hence, The correct logical arrangement is “IV, l, III, II”
